name: Voxel Adaptation for Photon Mapping
definition: Adapts photon mapping for real-time voxel raytracing by decoupling photon gathering from the rendering pass, storing indirect lighting data per-voxel to eliminate per-ray gathering overhead during trace.
summary: Voxel Adaptation for Photon Mapping enables real-time voxel raytracing by precomputing indirect lighting in a uniform grid, trading accuracy for speed.
